Need to reschedule existing HVAC service. Must use update_service, but first need service_id via find_service unless the user already has it. Also need new date and time window. Ask for identifying info and preferred new slot. Then will call tools. </think>

<action type="say">
I can help with that. To reschedule your HVAC service, I need a few details:

1) How should I look up the appointment?  
   - Confirmation code (preferred), or  
   - Your phone number or email used for the booking, and  
   - Roughly what day/time it’s currently scheduled for

2) What new day and time window do you want?  
   - Date (YYYY-MM-DD)  
   - Time window (e.g., “09:00-12:00”, “afternoon”, or “4-7pm”)

If you already know the service_id or confirmation code, you can just paste that along with your preferred new date and time window.</action>
